problem.passage:
The solution to the system of equations shown is (x, y).

y = 2x + 7
y = -2x - 9

What is the sum of the x-coordinate and y-coordinate of the solution to the system of equations shown?
problem.stimulus:
The solution to the system of equations shown is (x, y).

y = 2x + 7
y = -2x - 9
problem.question: What is the sum of the x-coordinate and y-coordinate of the solution to the system of equations shown?
problem.explanation: 두 식의 우변이 같으므로 2x + 7 = -2x - 9이다. 양변에서 정리하면 (4)x = -16이므로 x = -16 ÷ (4) = -4이다. 이를 y = 2x + 7에 대입하면 y = 2 × -4 + 7 = -1이다. 따라서 x좌표와 y좌표의 합은 -4 + -1 = -5이다.
problem.explanationEn: Since the right-hand sides are equal, 2x + 7 = -2x - 9. Rearranging gives (4)x = -16, so x = -16 ÷ (4) = -4. Substituting into y = 2x + 7 gives y = 2 × -4 + 7 = -1. So the sum of the x-coordinate and y-coordinate is -4 + -1 = -5.
